sloka: कुम्भकर्णो भृशं क्रुद्धः कपीन् खादन् प्रधावति ।। ६.६७.१०० ।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇo bhṛśaṁ kruddhaḥ kapīn khādan pradhāvati ।। 6.67.100 ।।

translations.english: Stretching his arms on all sides picking hundred, seven hundred, eight hundred and two hundred and three hundred, he ran devouring the vanaras.
